items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Claude Jones was on that band. Claude Jones, ever since I've known him, he wore a wig, you know.

ctx.x: Were there any (Inaudible) in any trombone players in any of those bands that you particularly enjoyed?

Yeah. Fletcher had some very good trombone players. He had J. C. Higginbotham and he had Sandy Williams -- was with that band. And Claude Jones was on that band. Claude Jones, ever since I've known him, he wore a wig, you know.
